text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nice shot♪ Nice on the green♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I went and played a round of golf, and I 
broke my record again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sending it flying into the blue sky with 
that exhilarating *ping*... Ahh, nothing 
beats it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Wanna come along next time, Trainer? I 
can teach you all sorts of things as your 
coach♪"

It seems Mejiro Palmer thoroughly enjoyed 
her day off.
